Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of G2911; to precipitate down:--cast down headlong.
BiblicalUsage: They rose up and thrust Jesus out of the city and led Him to the brow of the hill, to cast Him down headlong.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a town that tries to throw Jesus off a cliff has already decided it will not hear Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
